## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List executed checks and observed results; distinguish pending remote checks.

## Safety and compatibility

Explain any eligibility, privacy, recovery or platform change. Include protected counterexamples for new cleanup rules.

- [ ] Tests use synthetic data and no live provider credentials.
- [ ] Both READMEs and compatibility notes match the behavior.
- [ ] Generated Skill bundle is refreshed when applicable.
- [ ] No private paths, transcripts, credentials or inventories are included.
